data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word onus, meaning 'honor' or 'duty'. In Christianity, Onorata is a name given to honor saints and the virtues they embodied, such as piety and devotion. The name Onorata carries the meaning “Honorable, Pious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Onorata usually hope their child will grow to embody honorable, pious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
